name: The Standing Committee
text: End of Turn: Hedgerow folk touching this gain a quarter of the smallest one's stats.
golden_text: End of Turn: Hedgerow folk touching this gain half the smallest one's stats.

source.note: Pass 3; amended tribe gates and provisional paper B/C rates in content/pass3/rates.json.

details: Touching means the unbroken zigzag run through this, including this. Read its smallest Hedgerow unit once before gains. Shares round down and are permanent.
